justification: ANEF redone off the correct (verify-app) source. The brief's anef field now reuses the curated anef_zones table (Sydney — the source the /api/environmental/anef route uses) via PostGIS ST_Contains, and falls back to the existing portal_constraints.fetch_anef (Protection layer 2, regional airfields). Fixes the false 'outside contour' a Sydney lot would have got from the wrong source. Honest 'no published contour' where neither has data (never 'no aircraft noise'). Reuses existing sources; fail-safe.

pre_impl.existing_data: anef_zones (5 rows, Sydney YSSY ANEF 2039) with geometry_json jsonb + bbox columns and NO PostGIS geom column — the verify route bbox-prefilters then does JS point-in-polygon. portal_constraints.fetch_anef already queries Protection layer 2 (regional ANEF: Cessnock/Bankstown/Taree/Scone, no Sydney). _build_environmental already has lat/lng and _get_db_conn() exists.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: An earlier attempt wired ANEF to Protection layer 2 alone, which lacks Sydney — so a Sydney lot got a false 'outside aircraft noise'. Verified live: anef_zones returns ANEF 40 at Mascot and ANEF 30 at Haberfield (correct), where the wrong source returned nothing.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data source. fetch_anef_zone queries the existing anef_zones table (exact point-in-polygon via ST_Contains(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON), bbox pre-filtered); _anef_field combines it with the existing fetch_anef. DB coverage still wins; the field value is a string as before.
pre_impl.external_source_error: fetch_anef_zone wraps the query in try/except and returns None on any failure; _anef_field wraps each source and falls back: Sydney -> regional -> honest 'no published contour'; missing coords -> NOT_AVAILABLE. A DB or ArcGIS outage never blocks the brief and never over-states a contour.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend only. The anef DataField stays a string value (same schema); only its source string and the value text change. No frontend interface change.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a Sydney lot could read 'outside aircraft noise' (false) or 'not mapped'. After: Sydney lots read their real ANEF level, regional airfields read theirs, and elsewhere it says 'no published ANEF contour' — never the over-claim 'no aircraft noise'.

functions.name: fetch_anef_zone
functions.input: the latitude and longitude of a property to test against the curated Sydney anef_zones table
functions.output: a dict with the highest containing ANEF level and airport name, or None when the point is in no Sydney zone
functions.if_none: missing coordinates or any query exception returns None so the caller falls back to the regional source then a conservative note

functions.name: _anef_field
functions.input: uses the enclosing lot coordinates and overlay coverage to build the ANEF environmental DataField
functions.output: a DataField with the Sydney ANEF level, else the regional ANEF code, else an honest no-published-contour string
functions.if_none: with no coordinates it returns the existing NOT_AVAILABLE field, and any source error degrades to the next fallback

values: N/A - no regulatory values are hardcoded. ANEF levels and airport names are read from the authoritative anef_zones table and the Protection layer; thresholds are not invented.
queries: N/A for new tables - reuses the existing anef_zones table; the only query is a read-only point-in-polygon SELECT (bbox pre-filter + ST_Contains over the stored GeoJSON), parameterised, with a statement timeout via _get_db_conn.

break_it.scenario: A Sydney lot that the wrong source said was outside any contour
break_it.what_happens: a false 'outside aircraft noise' reassurance near the airport, the exact bug from the discarded Protection-only attempt
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_overlay_live_fallback.py::test_anef_sydney_zone_from_anef_zones ; live Mascot -> ANEF 40, Haberfield -> ANEF 30
break_it.how: fetch_anef_zone runs an exact ST_Contains point-in-polygon over the curated Sydney anef_zones table, returning the real contour level

break_it.scenario: A property near a regional airfield not in the Sydney table
break_it.what_happens: ignoring the regional ANEF would miss small-airport noise that users care about
break_it.how: when anef_zones has no match, _anef_field falls back to the existing fetch_anef (Protection layer 2) which holds the regional contours

break_it.scenario: A property far from any airport with no published ANEF anywhere
break_it.what_happens: claiming 'no aircraft noise' would over-state, since some airfields have no published ANEF at all
break_it.how: with both sources empty the field says 'No published ANEF contour at this property' — a fact about the data, not a claim about noise

break_it.scenario: The anef_zones query or the ArcGIS call fails, or coordinates are missing
break_it.what_happens: a naive combine could crash the brief or invent a contour
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_overlay_live_fallback.py::test_anef_missing_coords_is_not_available ; fetch_anef_zone except path returns None
break_it.how: each source is wrapped in try/except returning None, missing coords short-circuits to NOT_AVAILABLE, and the overlay tests stub both sources offline

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief on a Sydney lot (e.g. 25 Empire St Haberfield) and confirm the ANEF field reads 'ANEF 30 (Sydney)' rather than 'not mapped' or 'outside'. Confirm a remote lot reads 'No published ANEF contour at this property'. The verify app still uses anef_zones only (Sydney); this backend is more complete (adds the regional fallback).
